Cumulative effect sHR_n aggregates these increments, enabling prediction of future habit states. The timing model links specific reinforcement events to subsequent habit strength changes. These operators form a closed-loop system where past reinforcement history determines future behavior, with logarithmic approximations introducing bounded uncertainty. Dualities emerge between additive reinforcement and diminishing returns as habit strength grows. Failure modes include numerical instability when x approaches zero or excessive accumulation beyond model limits.
